name: tf2_rocketlauncher
stats_provenance: TF2 Soldier's stock Rocket Launcher as documented publicly: 4-rocket clip, 20 spare, 0.8 s between shots. Its rockets (90 base damage against 200-health Soldiers) do not one-shot the way Halo's do, so damage is scaled to 0.6 of the Halo rocket's -- that factor is ours.
view_model_mirrored_provenance: TF2 view models are authored right-handed (cl_flipviewmodels 0 is the default).
